assumptions: This is a CLI developer tool: the attacker-relevant input boundary is the command line of 'adt check ...' (user-supplied file/directory names interpolated into tool commands), not HTTP request parameters.

Typer handler parameters (functions decorated with @<app>.command/@<app.callback> in a module that imports typer and creates a typer.Typer() app) are extracted as the source family; matching is syntactic, to be confirmed during LLM labeling.
No AutoGluon- or Bikeshed-specific functions, modules or frameworks are assumed; all candidate families come from the imports and calls actually present in this repository.

Standard process-API families (subprocess/os/asyncio) are kept in the sink query for Pass 2 coverage consistency with prior projects; only subprocess.Popen has import and call evidence here, the other families will yield no rows.
Extraction is purely candidate-based: rows are candidates for LLM labeling, not confirmed vulnerabilities; no known-vulnerability location information was used or consulted.
